en.hero:
Seeing the world from
a runner's perspective.
en.intro: Not a pro athlete. Not a travel blogger. Just a guy who takes his running shoes everywhere, maps out runs and rates the local running conditions.
en.aboutExcerpt: I’m from Estonia, I work remotely in digital marketing, and I travel with my running shoes. It all started with karting and a plan to lose 20 to 25 kg.
en.aboutBody:
## It started with karting

Growing up in Estonia, I started with cross-country skiing. Snowboarding came later, along with a few injuries. By the time I was eighteen, I was spending more time partying and only occasionally going to the gym. Around 2018 to 2019, my weight had reached about **100 kg**.

I wanted to lose **20 to 25 kg for karting and motorsport**, and running became the way I tried to do it. It was a practical reason to start, long before I was thinking about taking running shoes on trips or writing about the places I ran.

![A kart race and me beside a racing kart in the paddock](/assets/uploads/my-story/karting.jpg "Karting was the reason I started running in the first place.")

## Nine marathon attempts, then a different focus

My running story now includes **nine marathon attempts**. Later, I shifted my focus towards **10 km**. I still enjoy having different kinds of running in my week, from an easy jog somewhere new to intervals and hill sessions.

## Rocca Sörk: running with other people

In **July 2025**, I started **Rocca Sörk together with Berit, Birgit and Kristjan**. It has since grown into a big running community by Estonian standards, far beyond the small group we began with.

Our regular **club run is every Tuesday at 18:30**. During the summer season, we also get together for **bike rides**, and from time to time we organise **larger events**. What started with running has become a way to bring people together around being active.

![Rocca Sörk runners warming up and running together, with Markus, Berit, Birgit and Kristjan in the middle photograph](/assets/uploads/my-story/rocca-sork-community.jpg "Rocca Sörk: club runs and events, with me, Berit, Birgit and Kristjan in the middle photo.")

You can find our latest runs, rides and events on [Rocca Sörk’s Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/roccasork/).

## Taking my running shoes everywhere

I work remotely in digital marketing, which gives me opportunities to travel. Over the past **six years**, I have run in many different places, and I am now taking the time to bring those routes, photos and memories together here.

Runograph is where I keep the useful parts of those experiences: the routes I actually ran, where I could settle into a rhythm, how safe it felt, what the surface was like and whether I would go back. The scores are my personal impressions of the running, and the maps make it easier to see which parts might suit your own trip.

I will keep adding places as I revisit old memories and take my shoes somewhere new.

et.intro: Ei ole profisportlane ega täiskohaga reisiblogija. Lihtsalt üks tüüp, kes võtab jooksutossud igale poole kaasa, kaardistab jooksupaiku ja hindab kohalikke jooksutingimusi.
et.aboutTitle:
Kõik algas kardisõidust.
Sellest sai eluviis.
et.aboutExcerpt: Murdmaasuusad, lumelaud, mõned vigastused ja ootamatu põhjus jooksma hakata. Nii see teekond algas.
et.aboutBody:
## Kõigepealt tuli lumi

Kasvasin üles Eestis, kus lumine talv tegi murdmaasuusatamisest loomuliku valiku. Hiljem hakkasin lumelauaga sõitma. See tundus lahedam, aga tõi kaasa ka vigastusi.

## Teistsugune stardijoon

Kaheksateistkümneselt pidutsesin palju ja jõusaali jõudsin pigem harva. Aastateks 2018-2019 oli kaal kerkinud umbes 100 kilogrammini. Kardisõidu ja motospordi nimel tahtsin alla võtta 20-25 kg. Sellest sai minu põhjus jooksma hakata.

## Üheksa maratonikatset. Seejärel uus fookus.

Minu jooksuteekonda kuulub üheksa maratonikatset. Hiljem nihkus fookus 10 km distantsile.

## Jooksmine koos teistega

Asutasin Rocca Sörgi. Jooksmisest oli saanud midagi, mida tahtsin teistega jagada.

## Kaugtöö ja jooksutossud

Töötan digiturunduses ja teen kaugtööd. Reisides käin alati jooksmas. See päevik toob kokku minu loo, uued paigad ja lihtsa harjumuse jooksutossud jalga panna.

Sihtkohtade lehed koondavad paigad, kus olen jooksnud. Täiendan neid enda tähelepanekute, fotode ja jooksukogemustega.
